en: Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a large crowd gathered in a cobbled town square for a parade or civic celebration. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century dress line up, many with umbrellas and hats, while a band or procession passes through the center. Behind them stand several three‑ and four‑story townhouses with steep tiled roofs and shopfronts at street level, decorated with wreaths and large vertical flags. German‑language shop signs are visible on the façades.
